optional_codes.reason: Long term (current) use of bisphosphonates: alendronate taken weekly since 2024 is a prescribed drug used continuously for a chronic condition, which fits category Z79, but no Tabular List instruction requires the code. Defensible either way.

unsupported_codes.reason: Osteoporosis with current pathological fracture: reporting a code from this category treats the vertebral fracture as current. The note documents it as a fracture of 2024 that has healed, with no new fracture.
Collapsed vertebra, not elsewhere classified, which includes compression fracture of vertebra NOS: reports the compression fracture as a current condition, and the note documents it as healed.
Fracture of thoracic vertebra: reports a current fracture of the vertebra, and the note documents a healed fracture and no new injury.
Pathological fracture, not elsewhere classified: reports a current pathological fracture, and the note documents none.

citations.M81.0: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting FY2027, Section I.C.13.d.1: category M81, Osteoporosis without current pathological fracture, is for use for patients with osteoporosis who do not currently have a pathologic fracture due to the osteoporosis, even if they have had a fracture in the past. Section I.C.13.d.2: category M80 is for patients who have a current pathologic fracture at the time of an encounter. Section IV.J: do not code conditions that were previously treated and no longer exist. The inclusion term at M81.0 is 'Osteoporosis NOS'. Here the provider documents osteoporosis and an osteoporotic compression fracture of the twelfth thoracic vertebra in 2024 that has healed, with no new fracture on today's films, so the osteoporosis is reported without a current fracture.
citations.Z87.310: ICD-10-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting FY2027, Section I.C.13.d.1: for patients with a history of osteoporosis fractures, status code Z87.310, Personal history of (healed) osteoporosis fracture, should follow the code from M81. Tabular List instruction at M81: use additional code to identify personal history of (healed) osteoporosis fracture, if applicable (Z87.310). The inclusion terms at Z87.310 include 'Personal history of (healed) collapsed vertebra due to osteoporosis'. Here the healed fracture is documented as osteoporotic, so the history code follows M81.0.

coder_notes: The visit is for osteoporosis, which is current and under treatment, so no follow-up examination code is used. The bone density result is behind the diagnosis and is not coded. Calcium and vitamin D are supplements, not shown as prescribed drugs, and get no long-term drug therapy code.
